notes: No source found that reports the aggregate match (5,362 SEC insiders, $555M, 2022-26), and no source gives Joe Craft's $8.2M 2022-26 federal total. Craft is widely covered as a GOP megadonor. Coverage found: 2012 super PAC gifts; 2023 max-outs to Trump rivals; January 2024 RNC Presidential Trust co-chair with an $826K opening gift. A search summary said Craft was among the top 2024 donors to America PAC, but no page with a verifiable quote was opened. A POLITICO Pro/E&E piece titled 'Coal titan Joe Craft spends big in final days of campaigns' (subscriber.politicopro.com/article/eenews/1060106425) turned up, but it was paywalled and returned no text, so it is not recorded. Kentucky Lantern pages returned 403. The Lantern reported a $1.5M gift from Joe Craft's trust to a super PAC in the 2023 Kentucky governor race; that is a state race, not FEC. No July-September 2026 coverage of Craft's giving was found.
